gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-saira: Relaxed and unhurried, Delius Unicase draws its letters like bent paperclip wire, with no swelling anywhere. And Saira, a sans with see-through s shapes and rounded forms stretching tall, gives that looseness a crisp place to land.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-sarpanch: Strokes that never taper, from start to finish, give Delius Unicase its relaxed charm and a pronounced x-height. But Sarpanch does the tidier work, with an open-mouthed e and compact ascenders that keep lines tight.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-savate: Savate has sturdy hairlines and a tall, round o. Delius Unicase, relaxed and unpinched, sits beside it like a friendly handwritten note beside a contemporary, clean neighbor whose open curves echo its looseness.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-schibsted-grote: Schibsted Grotesk looks wide-eyed, its a and e bowls tall. Delius Unicase brings a wire-bent looseness up top, so paragraphs below it flow forward without terminals closing in or any snag.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-scope-one: Delius Unicase writes with the flat line of a fineliner, relaxed and inviting, with a pronounced x-height and no tapering. Scope One brings traditional, refined polish and stubby ascenders underneath.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-sen: Delius Unicase hand-draws every letter at a relaxed, inviting pace, with no tapering at joins and a pronounced x-height. Sen supplies a modern counterpart, one constant line, lowercase built tall.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-sintony: One constant pen width runs through Delius Unicase, which keeps it relaxed, inviting and pleasantly unpinched. Sintony brings a chunky, tall midzone and a smooth, unclogged read, which is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px feels bookish and dignified, with large counters. If Delius Unicase were made small, its pipe-cleaner strokes would lose some of their relaxed, inviting bounce next to this serif.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans stands tall, its lowercase cut like acrylic stencil pieces, with no stroke modulation at all. Sofia Sans gives the relaxed, inviting Delius Unicase something modern to lean on.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-sofia-sans-semi: Narrow and crisp, with lowercase nearly matching the capitals, Sofia Sans Semi Condensed reads like a stencil-cut channel. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed holds the page steady while Delius Unicase loosens it up, relaxed and inviting.
